entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 399 aa bacterial protein with predicted N-terminal Flavoprotein domain PF02441 (residues 2-178) and C-terminal DFP domain PF04127 (residues 186-396).
Closest reviewed homologs include Bacillus subtilis CoaBC at 46.3% identity over 98.2% query coverage and another reviewed CoaBC at 42.6% identity over 99.0% coverage.
Likely bifunctional enzyme catalyzing sequential CoA-biosynthesis steps: phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase.
Likely binds FMN and Mg2+ based on close CoaBC homolog annotations; exact cofactor occupancy is inferred, not directly measured for this sequence.
Associated with coenzyme A biosynthesis, specifically pathway steps 2 and 3 of conversion from pantothenate to CoA.

entities.name: Bacillus subtilis CoaBC
observations: Reviewed bifunctional CoA biosynthesis enzyme with N-terminal phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase region and C-terminal phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase region.
Uses Mg2+ and binds one FMN per subunit according to curated annotation.
Catalyzes formation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine followed by decarboxylation to 4-phosphopantetheine.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: The query protein is associated by close-homolog evidence with CoA biosynthesis steps 2 and 3 from (R)-pantothenate.
The two reactions are phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligation followed by phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation.

entities.name: CoA intermediate ligation and decarboxylation
observations: Reaction 1: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP yields N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:19397.
Reaction 2: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine yields (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; Rhea RHEA:16793.
